description: A page in this batch writes 'Couchbase Enterprise Server 7.6', which is not the product's name in either order - the house forms are 'Couchbase Server' with an Enterprise Edition badge, or 'Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition'. Prior rounds logged several naming-drift issues in Capella's tree (cluster-manager role naming, storage-mode vocabulary); this is the same class of problem appearing in server/. It also embeds a version number in prose on a page under an 8.0 tree.
